description: This file implements serialization and deserialization logic for Web requests and responses, including handling of HTTP headers, content types, encoding, chunked transfer, and WebSocket extensions. It defines classes and methods for converting internal data structures to and from wire format, managing state during parsing, and handling compression and signature data.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents an HTTP request with methods for serialization and deserialization, including handling of headers, body, and WebSocket extensions.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents an HTTP response with methods for serialization and deserialization, including headers, status, and body.

classes.name: Signature
classes.description: Represents a cryptographic signature with type and data.

classes.name: Authorization
classes.description: Represents an authorization token with type and token string.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the request or response into a byte stream for transmission.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Parses incoming byte stream to reconstruct the request or response object.

methods.name: ParseContentType
methods.description: Parses the Content-Type header to extract MIME type and character set.

methods.name: ToSignature
methods.description: Converts a string into a Signature object, decoding base64 data.

methods.name: FromSignature
methods.description: Converts a Signature object into a string representation.

methods.name: ToAuthorization
methods.description: Parses an authorization header string into an Authorization object.

methods.name: FromAuthorization
methods.description: Converts an Authorization object into a string for header inclusion.
